summary.text: Mary Beth Imes is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 5 since 2021 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Imes is a business executive who works as director of Imes Funeral Home.

paragraphs.text: Mary Imes's career experience includes working as director of Imes Funeral Home.
She first took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Larry Elkins (R).

In the 2025-2026 session Imes was vice chair of the House Transportation Committee and also served on the Elections, Constitutional Amendments & Intergovernmental Affairs, Local Government, and State Government committees.
